step1_analysis.description: A 60 GHz cascode low-noise amplifier utilizing SiGe bipolar transistors. It consists of a common-emitter input stage (Q4) and a common-base output stage (Q1) to provide high gain and reverse isolation at millimeter-wave frequencies.

paper_reference.title: SiGe Bipolar Transceiver Circuits Operating at 60 GHz

voltage_gain.description: Voltage gain (S21) at the operating frequency of 60 GHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: SKY130 CMOS has a lower fmax compared to 200GHz SiGe HBTs. Gain at 60GHz will be significantly degraded.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard 130nm CMOS struggles to provide high gain at 60 GHz due to parasitic capacitances and lower transit frequency.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption from the 1.8V supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: P = VDD * I_total. Assuming similar bias currents of ~6mA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bias currents can be set similarly in SKY130, yielding comparable DC power.

noise_figure.description: Noise figure of the amplifier at 60 GHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: CMOS thermal noise and gate resistance noise at 60GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: 130nm CMOS will have a significantly higher noise figure at 60 GHz compared to a 200GHz fT SiGe HBT.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power consumption, AC voltage gain at 60 GHz, and transient response of the cascode LNA.
step3_testbench.spice:
* SiGe Bipolar LNA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt
.param W_xm1=1 L_xm1=1

* Generic BJT models for simulation
.model npn npn (is=1e-16 bf=100 tf=1p cje=10f cjc=10f)
.model pnp pnp (is=1e-16 bf=50 tf=2p cje=10f cjc=10f)

* DUT (with assumed component values for missing parameters)
R1 n3 label_net_0 1k
R2 n2 label_net_1 1k
Q1 n5 n2 n12 npn
R3 n3 label_net_2 1k
R4 n1 n7 1k
Q2 n2 n2 n1 npn
R5 n0 label_net_3 1k
Q3 n1 label_net_4 n1 npn
C1 n8 n9 1p
C2 n0 label_net_5 1p
R6 n6 label_net_6 100
C3 n3 label_net_7 1p
C4 n10 n2 1p
Q4 n12 n9 n6 npn
C5 n2 n12 1p
C6 n1 label_net_8 1p
R7 n5 n10 500
L1 n8 n11 1n
R8 n0 n8 1k
Q5 n11 n3 n13 pnp
R9 n4 label_net_9 1k
R10 n1 label_net_4 1k
R11 n0 n10 500
R12 n4 n13 1k

* Fix floating nodes from extraction
Rfix_n9 n9 label_net_1 100k
Rfix_n7 n7 0 1G

* VDD
Vvdd0 n0 0 1.8
Vvdd4 n4 0 1.8

* Bias
VLABEL_NET_0 label_net_0 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_1 label_net_1 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_2 label_net_2 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_3 label_net_3 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_4 label_net_4 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_5 label_net_5 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_6 label_net_6 0 0
VLABEL_NET_7 label_net_7 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_8 label_net_8 0 0.9
VLABEL_NET_9 label_net_9 0 0.9

* Input
Vin in 0 dc 0 ac 1
Cin in n8 1p

* Load
Cload n5 0 10f

.control
op
let power = -(i(Vvdd0) + i(Vvdd4)) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 20 1G 100G
let gain_db = vdb(n5) - vdb(in)
meas ac max_gain max gain_db
meas ac gain_60G find gain_db at=60G

tran 1p 200p
meas tran v_max max v(n5)
meas tran v_min min v(n5)
quit
.endc
.end
